tone.summary: A classic 80s new wave setup utilizing a Fender/JC style clean amp (US Deluxe) paired with Chorus and light OD boost for shimmering, bright textures.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a subtle, transparent edge-of-breakup and boost the high end.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its transparency rather than heavy drive, mimicking light grit.

blocks.purpose: Core texture for the 80s new wave sound; creates stereo sheen.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender/JC style tone required for new wave.
Match the small, bright cabinet clue and complement the US Deluxe amp model.
Enhance the bright top end and maintain clarity while avoiding mid-scoop.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the frequency response for maximum brightness.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle echo effect for depth without muddying the clean tone.
blocks.gap: The small delay is crucial for adding rhythmic sheen typical of 80s pop/new wave.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle space and sheen without the heavy wash of plate or spring reverb.
